detail.longDescription: If you run VirtualBox, VMware Workstation or an Android emulator on Windows 11, you may need the Windows Hypervisor Platform (WHP) turned on. It's an optional feature that gives third-party virtualization software access to the same hypervisor Windows uses itself. We walk through enabling and disabling it step by step: https:// geekrewind.com/how-to-turn-on- windows-hypervisor-platform-in-windows-11/ # Windows11 # Virtualization # OpenSource # VirtualBox # TechTutorial
